in_marathi.name: Devinder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi + Indra Devi: Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity Indra: King of Gods and Lord of Rains Therefore, Devinder can be considered a name that signifies the presence of both the Goddess of Wealth and the King of Gods.

in_bengali.name: Devinder
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Light
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devinder একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Devi + Indra Devi: Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity Indra: King of Gods and Lord of Rains Therefore, Devinder can be considered a name that signifies the presence of both the Goddess of Wealth and the King of Gods.
